lines.zh: 我展着大翅膀，从草上飞过。
lines.en: I sweep over the grass on wide wings.
I trace circles above the flowers.

lines.zh: 我在半空停了一下，再往前。
lines.en: I pause in midair, then move on.

lines.zh: 尾巴上的两条长带拖着。
lines.en: The long tails of my wings trail behind.
I settle on a blue flower.
Daytime is my time.
I fly along the field ridge.
I fly along the field ridge.

lines.zh: 我从这一片花到那一片。
lines.en: I go from this patch of flowers to that one.
Two beats, then a glide.

lines.zh: 我绕着那棵树飞了一圈。
lines.en: I circle that tree once.
I drop low and skim the grass tips.

lines.zh: 我飞进阳光里，翅膀发亮。
lines.en: I fly into the sun and my wings shine.
I tilt in the wind.
I cross above the fence.
I come back to the same flower.
I hold my wings open and stay still.

lines.zh: 花瓣上还留着我的脚印。
lines.en: My footprints remain on the petal.
I'm sunning myself.

lines.zh: 风把我的翅膀吹得动了。
lines.en: The wind stirs my wings.
This meadow is wide open.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的黑纹很清楚。
lines.en: The black markings on my wings are distinct.

lines.zh: 有只蜜蜂在旁边的花上。
lines.en: A bee is on the next flower.
I curl my antennae.

lines.zh: 我数过了，这里的花不少。
lines.en: I've counted — there are plenty of flowers here.
I don't move; the wind carries me.
I see birds far off.
This is my route.
You're standing on my flowers.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的帽檐飞过去。
lines.en: I fly close past your hat brim.
That hat of yours looks like a flower.
I land on the brim of your hat.
Keep your hand still.
Once I take off, I go high.

lines.zh: 你抬头的时候我在上面。
lines.en: When you look up, I'm above you.
Don't tread that patch of flowers.
I'm pollinating here.
This plain is vast, isn't it?
I drop into the flowers.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的粉掉了一块。
lines.en: A patch of dust has come off my wing.
I pause before flying again.
I land crooked on the grass.
My wings won't beat.
I crawl behind the flower stem.

lines.zh: 翅上的黑纹蹭掉了一角。
lines.en: A corner of the black pattern is scraped off.
I'm waiting for my strength.
I can't get high, but I can still fly.
It hurts a little.
That blue flower is mine.
I drop down and sniff first.
I'll stay on the flower a while.
There's still nectar in the stamens.
I turn half a circle on it.
The blue flower's nectar is sweet.
I've cleaned it up.
Are there other flowers?
I'll leave this one for others.
I'll come back to this patch.
The tip of my tail wing is bent.
I tilted and steadied.
I've landed on your arm.
My wings are more fragile than they look.

lines.zh: 别用手挥，扫到我就掉了。
lines.en: Don't swat; one hit and I'm down.
I move to the far side of the flower.
We both flinched.
I take off and bank around.

lines.zh: 你的袖子碰到了我的长尾。
lines.en: Your sleeve touched my long tails.
I settle on the grass nearby.
Another swallowtail flies over.
Its tails are longer than mine.
Your wing markings differ from mine.
It settles beside me.
We open our wings side by side.

lines.zh: 风把花粉吹到我们身上。
lines.en: The wind blows pollen onto us.
Afterward she goes looking for leaves.
The eggs will go on the leaves.

lines.zh: 我们的幼虫会吃光一片叶。
lines.en: Our larvae will strip a whole leaf.
I stay on the flower.
I land on your hand.
Your palm is too dry.
I walk along your finger.
My wing has creased.
I clutch it close and beat my wings.
Hold me up.
I can see the flowers.
Set me by the flower.
A little dust came off.
I'll fly there myself.
There's another bug on that flower.
Those blue blooms are waiting for me.
I spread my wings to the full.
My eyes are on that flower.
I rise and go over the top.
It's smaller than one of my wings.
I circle to the lee side first.
I hold position upwind of it.
I wasn't wrong — it's right ahead.
I charged in; the wings will not slow.
I circle above it.
It hasn't noticed.
I slip down along the petals.
The wind lifts my wings for me.

lines.zh: 我翅膀的影子落在它身上。
lines.en: My wing's shadow falls on it.
It glanced upward.
I hold for a beat.
My swallowtail swings. I come from the side.
One foot lower.
I drop another half foot.
I strike it with a gust from my wings.
I beat it with my wings.
I push it with my legs.
It's shoved off the petal.
I wobble too.
My wings got no force behind them.
I circle back.
It left the flower.

lines.zh: 我翅膀后头，拖着两条尾。
lines.en: Two tails trail from my wings.
One of my long tails was pulled.
I emerge from the chrysalis at first light.

lines.zh: 翅膀还是软的，要挂一会儿。
lines.en: My wings are soft; I must hang a while.
I try opening them on the grass.
The flowers here are all open.
I smell blue flowers.

lines.zh: 我飞到最高的那片叶上。
lines.en: I fly to the highest leaf.
The wind takes me up.

lines.zh: 燕尾似的后翅，飞起来有点沉。
lines.en: These swallow tails drag a little in flight.
This is open plain.
I start looking for the first flower.

lines.zh: 火苗燎过，我的长尾巴先卷了。
lines.en: A flame licks by and my long tails curl first.

lines.zh: 我从空中掉下来，摔在花上。
lines.en: I drop out of the air onto the flowers.

lines.zh: 一滴水压住我的翅膀，飞不动了。
lines.en: A drop of water pins my wings and I can't fly.
I'm flung into the air.
The fletching grazes my wing.
That light makes my wings snap stiff.

lines.zh: 蜜源不够，我飞得越来越沉。
lines.en: With too little nectar, my flight grows heavy.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我整只贴在草上。
lines.en: At the flash I flatten against the grass.

lines.zh: 没有花，也没有风，我一路落。
lines.en: No flowers, no wind; I fall all the way.
